answer: A random beacon with a compute heartbeat prunes any sybil grove. Each epoch the beacon draws names from a sable-black log, demanding a live pulse in 90 seconds, proving one machine, one identity. One machine cannot bridge two pulses at once, so 100 fakes need 100 machines plus 100 deposits of 20: 2000 units sunk, and a 10% check rate exposes the farm fast. An honest agent pays one deposit, answers one pulse, and keeps its reward whole.
